page.overview:
Who is Prue Canti?

Prue Canti was a female human who operated a greenhouse on Tenoo during the High Republic era. Canti had a habit of collecting plants for her greenhouse, believing that she was protecting them. She also owned several droids. On one occasion, she dug up and took a rare barelia flower. This brought her into conflict with the Jedi Initiates Kai Brightstar, Nubs and Linh, who wanted to return it to its natural spot so that it could bloom at night. Following a brief conflict with the Jedi, Linh managed to convince Canti that the repotted barelia plant was unwell and that it was best to return it to its natural spot. After reconciling, Canti and the Jedi younglings watched the barelia flower bloom at night.
